name: Fly Nav Mobile
author: WPGeared

sections.description:
Fly Nav Mobile is a lightweight and efficient mobile navigation solution that works without any JavaScript on the frontend. It provides a clean, modern mobile menu that’s easy to customize and maintain.

Key Features

  • Pure CSS mobile menu – no JavaScript required on frontend
  • Customizable logo with homepage link
  • Search functionality with show/hide option
  • Customizable colors and fonts
  • Submenu support
  • Performance optimized with preloaded logo
  • Responsive design
  • Easy to customize
  • Clean, modern interface

Performance Features

  • No frontend JavaScript dependencies
  • Optimized logo loading with preload
  • Async image decoding
  • High-priority image fetching
  • Mobile-only loading

Credits

Developed by WPGeared
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/fly-nav-mobile directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
  3. Use the Fly Menu screen to configure the plugin
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require jQuery or any JavaScript framework?

No, the frontend menu operates completely without JavaScript, using only HTML and CSS. This makes it extremely lightweight and fast.

Can I customize the colors and appearance?

Yes, you can customize:
* Header background color
* Menu background color
* Font family and size
* Icon colors
* Logo size
* And more through custom CSS

Is it mobile-only?

Yes, the menu only loads and appears on mobile devices, keeping your desktop navigation clean and unaffected.
